values.note: City of Wakefield 2026 rate sheet (rates effective 12/13/2021): $35 a day for lots 2-47 and 53-65, $50 for the accessible drive-through lots 48-52, the same for residents and non-residents. Weekly, monthly and season rates differ: non-residents pay $165 / $525 / $1,500 a week / month / season on the standard lots, residents $140 / $425 / $1,300. Walk-in rustic tent sites $15.

fees.source: https://cityofwakefieldmi.gov/wp-content/uploads/2026/01/Campground-Rates-2026.pdf (Wakefield Resident and Non-Wakefield Resident rate tables: DAY $35.00 / $50.00), read 2026-10-25

hookups.source: https://cityofwakefieldmi.gov/wp-content/uploads/2026/01/Campground-Rates-2026.pdf ('Water; Electric; Sewer; (20, 30 & 50 Amp Services) at all sites'), read 2026-10-25

values.note: RV lots 2-65 (site 1 is the camp host's) plus five walk-in rustic tent sites. The city's dimension sheet gives each lot a 'fits' length from 21 to 45 ft: lakeside lots 4-24 mostly 32-45 ft (20-23 only 21-27 ft), drive-through lots 31-37, 47-53 and 61 to 37-45 ft; lots 48-52 are paved and accessible.

sites.source: https://cityofwakefieldmi.gov/play/ ('The campground features 71 sites for RV or tent camping') + https://cityofwakefieldmi.gov/wp-content/uploads/2024/12/Camp-Site-Dimensions-2024.pdf (Width, Length, Fits, Pull Thru, Pad per site), read 2026-10-25

values.note: 2026: opens Friday, May 15 at 6 pm, closes Sunday, October 4 at 4 pm; 'The Camping Season will vary depending on the weather.'

season.source: https://cityofwakefieldmi.gov/wp-content/uploads/2026/01/Campground-Policy-2026.pdf ('Eddy Park Campground will open on Friday, May 15, 2026, at 6pm and close on Sunday, October 4, 2026, at 4pm') + https://cityofwakefieldmi.gov/play/, read 2026-10-25

facilities.source: https://cityofwakefieldmi.gov/play/ ('Restroom and shower facilities are located on site'), read 2026-10-25

values.note: Booked online on the city's Campground Booking page; daily, weekly and monthly reservations for the season open in early February (2026: Monday, Feb 2, 8 AM CST). Seasonal campers rebook their sites through the City Clerk (906-229-5131 ext. 1002) by October 1. Refunds: 100% Feb 3-29, 50% Mar 1-18, 25% Mar 19 - Apr 8, none after.

booking.source: https://cityofwakefieldmi.gov/wp-content/uploads/2026/01/Campground-Policy-2026.pdf ('Beginning Monday, February 2, 2026, at 8:00 AM CST Online Reservations for monthly, weekly, and daily camping may be made by following the link below https://reserve.campgroundbooking.com/eddy-park'), read 2026-10-25

note: City of Wakefield campground on Sunday Lake, a short walk from Eddy Park's sandy beach and swim area, boat launch and playground. Campground hosts on site Memorial Day through mid-October. --Claude
summary: City page (Eddy Park section) + 2026 rate sheet, policy and site-dimension PDFs: confirmed 50 A / water / sewer at all sites, 71 sites, showers, online booking; added $35-50 a night (same for residents; resident discount only on weekly/monthly/season rates), RVs to 45 ft with drive-throughs, season May 15 - Oct 4 (2026), Campground Booking engine. Note dropped facts the fields hold and the wrong '15/30/50-amp' (20/30/50) and '~Memorial Day-mid Oct' season. The city has no page for the park beyond the Eddy Park section of its 'play' page, so that link stays. Dump station not stated by the city (derived value left). Phone 906-224-4481 is the city's campground number.
flags: Waterfront re-audit lead: the city's site-dimension sheet types lots 4-24 as 'Lakeside' (21 of the RV lots), contrary to the stored 'lakeview'.
